name: Japan Excellent, Inc.
summary: Japan Excellent, Inc. (hereinafter, JEI) under the Law Concerning Investment Trusts and Investment Corporations of Japan, is a real estate investment corporation which primarily invests in office buildings. JEI is externally managed by a licensed asset management company, Japan Excellent Asset Management (JEAM). JEAM was originally owned 45% by NIPPON STEEL KOWA REAL ESTATE CO., LTD., 20% by The Dai-ichi Life Insurance Company, Limited, 15% by Sekisui House, Co., LTD., and 20% by other corporations.
